title: Currencies & FX
subtitle: Manage your base currency, foreign currencies, and exchange rates

compact.description: Your organization currently operates in a single currency. Add a foreign currency to enable multi-currency support.
compact.flagUnavailable: Multi-currency isn't included in your current plan.

setBaseConfirm.title: Set base currency?
setBaseConfirm.description: This becomes your organization's functional currency. It locks automatically once the first order is posted.

deactivateConfirm.title: Deactivate this currency?
deactivateConfirm.description: It will no longer be available for new activity. This is blocked while the currency has open orders, invoices, balances, or drawers.

empty.title: No currencies yet
empty.description: Add your organization's base currency to get started.

empty.title: No exchange rates yet
empty.description: Add a manual rate or import rates from CleanMateX HQ.

rejectConfirm.title: Reject this rate?
rejectConfirm.description: Explain why this draft rate is being rejected.

voidConfirm.title: Void this approved rate?
voidConfirm.description: The rate becomes inactive. Enter a corrected rate as a new draft afterward.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this draft rate?
deleteConfirm.description: This permanently removes the draft. Only draft rates can be deleted.

form.rateHint: Units of "To" currency per 1 unit of "From" currency

hqCopy.title: From CleanMateX HQ
hqCopy.description: Bring in CleanMateX's reference exchange rates for your currency pairs. Imported rates are a snapshot — a later change at HQ never silently changes your history.
hqCopy.empty: No new HQ rates to import for your current currencies.
hqCopy.committed: {count, plural, one {# rate imported} other {# rates imported}}
hqCopy.skippedDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# rate was skipped (already imported)} other {# rates were skipped (already imported)}}

csv.title: From CSV
csv.description: Bulk-import rates from a CSV file. Coming soon.

excel.title: From Excel
excel.description: Bulk-import rates from an Excel file. Coming soon.

url.title: From a provider URL
url.description: Fetch live rates from a curated provider. Coming soon.

converter.title: Currency Converter
converter.description: Preview a conversion using your resolved exchange rate — your own rate book first, then CleanMateX HQ's, per your resolution policy.
converter.staleWarning: This rate is older than its configured freshness window.
converter.noRate: No approved rate is available for this currency pair yet.

settings.title: FX Policy

resolutionPolicyValue.TENANT_THEN_HQ: Your rates first, then CleanMateX HQ's

settings.autoApproveImportsDescription: When on, rates you import land already approved (only for users who can also approve rates). When off, every import lands as a draft awaiting approval.
